:::{#thm-bernoulli-loglik-contribution}
#### Log-likelihood contribution of one binary outcome

If $\Outvar_\iobs \sim \Ber(\prob)$ has observed value $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$,
its [log-likelihood](#def-loglik) contribution is:

$$\llik_\iobs(\prob) = \outvar_\iobs \logf{\prob} + (1 - \outvar_\iobs) \logf{1 - \prob}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-loglik-contribution, worked in @sol-bernoulli-loglik-contribution.

:::
